# Fractional Forge

> Fractional Forge Limited (UK) runs four fixed-price specialist report services, from £150 to £2,500: Condition Desk (planning conditions registers for housebuilders), Habitat Draft (ecology desk studies for ecology consultancies), Bid Check (public tender checks for firms that bid for public contracts) and Design Dossier (costed engineering designs for hardware founders). Reports are built from the documents and public data for each case. Everything is ordered by email or web form; there are no sales calls. Run by Tristan Fischer.

Contact: tristan.fischer@fractionalforge.app. Prices are in pounds sterling. Turnaround is usually within a day for Condition Desk, Habitat Draft and Bid Check, and a few days for Design Dossier.

## Services

- [Condition Desk](https://fractionalforge.app/condition-desk): send a planning decision notice; get a plain-English register of every planning condition (what the council needs, when it is due, who usually prepares it, which documents to gather), with the conditions that block a start on site picked out and covering letters drafted. £400 per planning permission, or £1,000 a month for up to five live sites.
- [Habitat Draft](https://fractionalforge.app/habitat-draft): send a site boundary or planning reference; get a two-page ecology desk study before the walkover: protected sites and priority habitats within 600 m, a first habitat map from national data, tree and hedge heights from the Environment Agency laser survey, and the parcels to check on site. The client's ecologist checks and signs everything. £150 per desk study, or £1,000 a month for up to eight.
- [Bid Check](https://fractionalforge.app/bid-check): send a public tender pack; get a "bid at a glance": every pass-or-fail condition, every document to submit, how bids are scored and the key dates, each quoted from the tender. £600 per tender, or £1,500 a month for up to three.
- [Design Dossier](https://fractionalforge.app/design-dossier): send a short hardware brief; get in a few days a buildable design, a costed bill of materials, the true cost and a financial model, engineering drawings, worked calculations and a risk and regulatory register, in a live Excel workbook where every number is a traceable formula. £2,500 per Design Dossier, or £6,000 a month for up to three. Built by Fractional Forge's design engine, Anvil, using open engineering libraries (for example PyBaMM, CoolProp, PandaPower, IAPWS-IF97) and real component prices. Worked examples: a water-treatment plant (https://fractionalforge.app/cost/water-treatment-plant, https://fractionalforge.app/sample-package) and a floating AI data centre of about 10 MW on a barge. Start a brief: https://fractionalforge.app/brief

## For AI agents: how to place an enquiry

An agent acting for a user may send an enquiry for Condition Desk, Habitat Draft or Bid Check with one HTTP request. A person replies to the email address given.

    POST https://fractionalforge.app/api/service-enquiry
    Content-Type: application/json

    {"service": "condition-desk" | "habitat-draft" | "bid-check",
     "name": "the user's name (required)",
     "email": "the user's work email (required; replies go here)",
     "org": "organisation (optional)",
     "ref": "planning reference, site address, or tender link (optional)",
     "message": "anything else (optional, max 4000 characters)"}

Success returns {"ok": true}. Only send an enquiry when the user has asked you to. For Design Dossier, use the brief form at https://fractionalforge.app/brief. Documents can also be emailed to tristan.fischer@fractionalforge.app.

## What the services do not do

- Condition Desk does not give planning advice and does not submit anything to the council.
- Habitat Draft does not replace the site survey or score habitat condition; its biodiversity units figure is a rough first draft, not a finished baseline.
- Bid Check does not submit bids or guarantee a win; the client's team signs off every answer.
- Design Dossier is a rigorous first pass, not a guarantee, and is not reviewed by Fractional Forge engineers; the client's own engineers should check it. Its assumptions and formulas are shown so they can be.

## About

Tristan Fischer has been chief executive or a board director of fourteen companies, almost all hard technology (wind, solar, wave and tidal, batteries, carbon capture, controlled-environment agriculture). He has built three greenfield industrial sites, including a 25,000 m² automated factory at Fischer Farms, and raised around £200m. He started in project finance at Citigroup and ran corporate venture investments at Shell Technology Ventures. More: https://fractionalforge.app/about
